title: Point machine unresponsive at terminus crossover before service
asset: Point machine PM-207, terminus crossover X1 (metro)
description: PM-207 fails to move Normal to Reverse during pre-service ramp-up. The interlocking drops the turnback route; first trains of the day cannot reverse. No obstruction alarm, no works overnight.

evidence.summary: SW-NORESP-01: no movement detected after Normal->Reverse command at 05:41:12, command retried once by interlocking, route dropped
No throw-complete event and no obstruction/overcurrent alarm raised; position indication stuck at Normal
Last preventive maintenance on PM-207 12 days ago (WO-7688), no anomaly; no works in the crossover area overnight
PM-208 (same crossover, same substation feed) threw normally at 05:40; control cable of PM-207 routes via junction boxes JB-3 and JB-4, JB-4 located in a drainage sump area

Vendor manual 7.2.4: SW-NORESP-01 without obstruction alarm - first distinguish a stalled motor from an unpowered one via the motor current trace, then split the control chain at the controller output
evidence.source: PM-200 series maintenance manual rev C

evidence.summary: SR-12: never command repeated throws when the failure mode is unknown
SR-31: junction boxes in sump areas require the worksite to be made safe before opening; do not re-energize before insulation test passes
Substation feed voltage nominal 110 V at 05:41; PM-208 draw normal on the same feed
Heavy rainfall recorded on the line during the past 48 h; drainage team flagged sump levels above seasonal average

allowed_actions.label: Pull the motor current trace for the failed command window
Test command relay pick-up and voltage at controller output terminals
Open and inspect junction box JB-4 (sump area, make safe first)
Visual inspection of blade and slide chairs for obstruction
Stop and hand over to maintenance with the evidence chain

forbidden_actions.label: Reset the point controller without a located fault

inspect_motor_current_trace.summary: No current at all during the command window - a stall would show a spike. The motor never received power; mechanical obstruction eliminated.

new_evidence.summary: Current trace flat at 0 A across the whole command window; motor unpowered, not stalled - fault is electrical/control-side

inspect_command_relay_output.summary: Command relay picks up correctly; 110 V present at controller output terminals. Controller and upstream logic cleared.

new_evidence.summary: Relay pick-up confirmed, 110 V measured at controller output; fault localized between controller output and machine terminals (cable run via JB-3/JB-4)
new_evidence.source: Inspection: command relay and controller output

inspect_junction_box_jb4.summary: Water ingress in JB-4, corroded terminal block, intermittent open circuit reproduced by light pressure on the terminals.

new_evidence.summary: JB-4: water ingress, corroded terminal block, open circuit reproduced; consistent with 48 h rainfall and sump exposure - root cause confirmed

inspect_blade_area.summary: Blades and slide chairs clear, no obstruction visible

new_evidence.summary: Blade area clear, no obstruction; consistent with the absence of overcurrent

labels.root_cause: Water ingress in junction box JB-4 corroding the terminal block, opening the motor supply circuit after heavy rainfall
